en.dialog.closeWorktreeCleanDisk: Close Clean Up Worktree Disk dialog
en.error.branchConflict: The branch name already exists or is in use by another Worktree. Choose a new name when creating, or use Import for an existing Worktree.
en.error.connectionDisposed: The Worktree connection has closed. Refresh the page or restart DSH, then retry.
en.error.connectionFailed: The Worktree service could not be reached. Check that DSH is running and connected, then retry. Restart DSH first if you just installed the plugin.
en.error.gitAccessDenied: Git cannot access the repository or directory. Check file permissions, repository ownership, and the DSH access scope, then retry.
en.error.gitInvalidBranch: The branch name does not meet Git naming rules. Choose a valid name, such as feature/my-task, then retry.
en.error.gitLocalChanges: Git found uncommitted or untracked files and blocked this action. Commit or back up changes you want to keep, then inspect the directory and retry.
en.error.gitLocked: Another operation has locked the Git repository. Wait for other Git operations to finish, then retry. If the lock remains, check the lock file in a terminal after confirming no Git process is running.
en.error.gitNotInstalled: Git could not be found. Install Git or add it to PATH, restart DSH, then retry.
en.error.gitOperationFailed: The Git operation failed. Check that Git is available and the directory is accessible, then inspect git status in a terminal. Resolve the Git error before retrying.
en.error.gitTimeout: The Git operation timed out. Check that the repository is accessible and that no other Git operation is stuck, then retry.
en.error.initialCommitRequired: The Git repository has no commits yet. Make the first commit in the Workspace directory, then retry.
en.error.invalidResult: The Worktree service returned unrecognized data. Restart DSH and refresh the page. If it still fails, check that your plugin and DSH versions are compatible.
en.error.permissionBindingRequired: Permissions cannot be set until the Session is bound to a valid Worktree. Retry Binding in Settings → Worktree → Errors & recovery, then confirm Full Access.
en.error.sessionAlreadyBound: This Session is already bound to another Worktree. Open its original Worktree or create a new Session in the target Worktree.
en.error.sessionArchived: This Session is archived and cannot be rebound. Restore it in DSH or create a new Session in the target Worktree.
en.error.sessionBindingFailed: Session {sessionId} was retained, but its Worktree binding failed. {reason}
en.error.sessionCreationUnavailable: Session creation is unavailable; retry after reconnecting.
en.error.sessionCwdMismatch: The Session working directory does not match this Worktree, so it cannot be bound. Create a Session in the target Worktree or select one with a matching directory.
en.error.sessionFactsIncomplete: The Session details have not fully loaded, so its working directory cannot be verified. Wait and refresh the list, then retry.
en.error.sessionListNotReady: The Session list is still loading. Wait a moment, then retry. Reconnect to DSH if it does not finish loading.
en.error.sessionNotFound: This Session could not be found. Refresh the DSH Session list, then select an existing Session.
en.error.sessionOrderingUnavailable: Session ordering is unavailable; retry after reconnecting.
en.error.sessionRenameUnavailable: Session rename is unavailable; retry after reconnecting.
en.error.sidecarCorrupt: The Worktree management index is damaged or incompatible, so changes are blocked. Keep a backup and contact the maintainer for recovery. You can continue using native DSH Sessions.
en.error.sidecarSyncRequired: The Git operation and management index are out of sync. Choose Retry Recovery in Settings → Worktree → Errors & recovery, then refresh the list. Avoid repeating creation or cleanup.
en.error.sidecarUnavailable: The Worktree management index cannot be read or written. Check permissions and free space in the DSH data directory, then retry. Native Sessions remain available.
en.error.unexpected: The operation failed (error code: {code}). Refresh and retry. If it still fails, share the error code and DSH logs with the maintainer.
en.error.workspaceDeleteUnavailable: Workspace delete is unavailable; retry after reconnecting.
en.error.workspaceNotFound: This Workspace cannot be accessed. Check that it still exists in DSH and that its directory path and read permissions are valid, then refresh the list.
en.error.workspaceNotGitRepository: This Workspace is not a Git repository. Open Create Worktree and follow the setup guidance to initialize Git and make the first commit.
en.error.workspaceOrderingUnavailable: Workspace ordering is unavailable; retry after reconnecting.
en.error.workspaceRenameUnavailable: Workspace rename is unavailable; retry after reconnecting.
en.error.workspaceRootMissing: The Workspace directory is missing: {rootPath}. Restore it, or remove this Workspace in DSH and add the correct directory, then retry.
en.error.worktreeActivityUnavailable: Linked Session activity could not be checked. Check your DSH connection, refresh the Session list, then retry.
en.error.worktreeAlreadyManaged: This Worktree is already managed. Refresh the list and open its existing entry instead of importing it again.
en.error.worktreeCreatedSessionUnavailable: Worktree created, but Session creation is unavailable; retry after reconnecting.
en.error.worktreeDataUnavailable: Worktree data could not be loaded. Check your connection to DSH, then retry. The existing list is preserved.
en.error.worktreeIdentityChanged: The Worktree or repository no longer matches its registered location. Check the directories; if a Worktree was moved, run git worktree repair, then refresh and retry recovery.
en.error.worktreeImportInvalid: This directory cannot be imported. Select a branch-attached, unmanaged Worktree from the import list in the same Git repository, excluding the main directory, then retry.
en.error.worktreeMutationBusy: Another operation is changing this Worktree. Wait for it to finish, then retry. If it remains busy, check your other DSH instances.
en.error.worktreeNotFound: This Worktree or its directory cannot be accessed. Check that the directory exists and is readable, then refresh. If it was moved, run git worktree repair in a terminal first.
en.error.worktreeOrderingUnavailable: Worktree ordering is unavailable; retry after reconnecting.
en.error.worktreeOrderInvalid: The Worktree list changed, so the order could not be saved. Refresh the list, then drag the rows again.
en.error.worktreePermissionConfirmationRequ: The Session and binding were retained, but Full Access has not been confirmed. Retry Binding in Settings → Worktree → Errors & recovery and complete the permission confirmation; no new Session is needed.
en.error.worktreePermissionFailed: Worktree Session permissions could not be set; the Session was retained. Check the Session permission settings in DSH, then retry from Settings → Worktree → Errors & recovery.
en.error.worktreeRecordMissing: The Worktree registration result could not be confirmed. Refresh the list to check whether creation or import succeeded before repeating the operation. Retry if it is absent.
en.error.worktreeRecoveryRequired: A previous Worktree operation still needs recovery, so this action is blocked. Choose Retry Recovery in Settings → Worktree → Errors & recovery, then retry once recovery completes.
en.error.worktreeRegistrationSessionUnavail: The Worktree was registered, but Session creation is unavailable; retry after reconnecting.
en.error.worktreeRemoved: This Worktree is archived or cleaned up and cannot perform this action. Restore an archived Worktree, or create or import another one if its disk files were cleaned up.
en.error.worktreeSessionBusy: A linked Session or subagent is still running. Wait for it to finish or stop the task in DSH, then retry.
en.error.worktreeSessionRepairRequired: The Session binding needs repair. Use Retry Binding in Settings → Worktree → Errors & recovery. If the directory was moved, run git worktree repair first.
en.error.worktreeSessionUnavailable: This Worktree cannot open or create a Session. Check that its directory exists, has not been cleaned up, and does not need recovery, then refresh and retry.
en.error.worktreeStateConflict: The Worktree, branch, or saved content changed. Refresh, select again, and reconfirm the action. If editing, copy your draft before cancelling and reopening the editor.
en.mode.label: Worktree
en.permission.fallbackWorkspaceWrite: The Worktree Full Access preset is unavailable; workspace-write is active with approval prompts enabled. If you just installed or updated Worktree, restart DSH Desktop, or restart the DSH Web server and refresh this page. If the preset is still unavailable after restart or Git encounters access restrictions, check the DSH plugin configuration and Session permission settings.
en.permission.fullAccessAcknowledge: I understand the risks and want to continue
en.permission.fullAccessDescription: Worktree Full access lets this Session access linked Git metadata and Worktree files outside the Session directory. It disables filesystem confinement for this Session while keeping approval prompts enabled; network and process policy are unchanged. Target Worktree: {cwd}
en.permission.presetRestartRequired: The Worktree Full Access preset is unavailable. If you just installed or updated Worktree, restart DSH Desktop, or restart the DSH Web server and refresh this page. The workspace-write fallback remains in use.
en.permission.unavailable: Worktree Session permissions could not be read. Check your DSH connection and the Session permission settings, then retry.
en.permission.unverified: Session permissions could not be verified; the Session was retained. Check the permission settings in DSH. Permission updates after cleanup can be retried in Settings → Worktree → Errors & recovery.
en.permission.userRestricted: Your selected DSH permission restrictions were preserved. If the task needs more access, adjust this Session’s native permission settings and retry.
en.restartRequired: Worktree is installed. Restart DSH Desktop, or restart the DSH Web server and refresh this page, to enable it.
en.session.name: Session name
en.settings.description: Worktree mode groups Sessions by Git worktree. Failures appear as toasts; explanations, diagnostics and recovery actions are collected in Errors & recovery.
en.settings.reopen: Reopen the corresponding Workspace, Dashboard or operation dialog to load its current state and enable recovery actions.
en.settings.retention: Records stay in memory for this page and clear on reload. Read the problem and suggested solution before retrying.
en.settings.title: Worktree
en.settings.toastHint: Details and recovery: Settings → Worktree → Errors & recovery.
en.tools.autoHint: Inject selected tools before Sessions in this Worktree execute, independently of General settings.
en.tools.autoSelectionHint: Choose capabilities to inject into this Worktree.
en.tools.commandHint: Enable /cluworktree to activate the selected capabilities in the current conversation. Turning this off removes the command.

en.tools.delegate.hint: Create and bind a Session in a Worktree, select its model and dispatch a task. The executing Session can report results.
en.tools.delegate.title: Delegate tasks
en.tools.failed: Unable to read or save tool settings. Retry to load the latest configuration.
en.tools.localAutoHint: Inject selected tools before Local/Main Sessions in this Workspace execute, independently of General settings.
en.tools.localAutoSelectionHint: Apply only to Local/Main Sessions in this Workspace.
en.tools.message.hint: Send follow-up tasks to existing Sessions or steer running work at a native step boundary.
en.tools.message.title: Continue Sessions
en.tools.models.hint: Find available models and reasoning options for delegated tasks.
en.tools.models.title: Discover models
en.tools.reportHint: Delegated Sessions receive only result reporting by default.
en.tools.runtimeHint: Deselecting all turns the switch off. Changes affect future injection; active tools remain until the Agent ends.
en.tools.sessions.hint: Find Session identities, titles and execution status in the current Workspace or a selected Worktree.

en.tools.worktrees.hint: Find Worktrees, branches, paths and availability in the current Workspace.

en.workspace.deleteDescription: Delete {name}? This removes only the DSH Workspace registration. The directory, Sessions, and Git Worktrees will be retained.
en.workspace.duplicate: A Workspace with this name already exists. Choose a different name.
en.workspace.name: Workspace name
en.worktree.adoptBeforeClean: Adopt the current branch first; for detached HEAD, check out a branch in Git first.
en.worktree.adoptDescription: Update the recorded branch from “{previous}” to “{current}”? Only the plugin index changes; Session bindings and disk files are preserved.
en.worktree.archiveDescription: Archive {name}? It moves to the Archived group. Disk files, Session bindings, and working directories are preserved; existing Sessions remain usable. Deleting the directory requires the separate Clean Disk action.
en.worktree.archiveExternalDescription: Archive {name}? It moves to the Archived group. The external directory, Session bindings, and working directories are preserved; existing Sessions remain usable. Deleting the directory requires the separate Clean Disk action.
en.worktree.branchDriftGuidance: The current branch differs from the recorded branch. If intentional, choose Adopt Current Branch from this Worktree menu; otherwise switch back in Git and refresh. Session bindings and working directories are preserved.
en.worktree.cleanDiskDescription: Delete {name} ({path}) from disk? This operation cannot be undone. The plugin does not check whether Sessions or subagents are running. Confirm that all tasks using this directory have stopped; otherwise deletion may cause task failures or data loss. If the directory or .git is already absent, only the Worktree removal status is synchronized; remaining files are not deleted. Linked Sessions and history are preserved.
en.worktree.createDescription: {name} · the Worktree path is managed by DSH.
en.worktree.detachedGuidance: This directory has a detached HEAD. Switch to the intended local branch in Git and refresh, then choose Adopt Current Branch if it differs from the recorded branch.
en.worktree.forgetDescription: Remove {name} from Worktree plugin management? Disk directories and Sessions in DSH will be retained.
en.worktree.importDescription: Register an existing Worktree for {name}. Registration and archiving preserve the directory; only a separately confirmed Clean Disk action deletes it.
en.worktree.name: Worktree name
en.worktree.noBranches: No local branches found in this Workspace.
en.worktree.recoveryGuidance: A previous operation is incomplete, or the directory and repository identity could not be verified. Check that the original directory and repository are accessible, then choose Retry Recovery from this Worktree menu. If it still fails, keep the error details for diagnosis; do not delete the plugin index manually.
en.worktree.removeDescription: Archive {name}? The directory, Session bindings, and working directories are preserved. Deleting the directory requires the separate Clean Disk action.
en.worktree.removeExternalDescription: Archive {name}? The external directory, Session bindings, and working directories are preserved. Deleting the directory requires the separate Clean Disk action.
en.worktree.repairGuidance: Check the directory, .git entry, and Git Worktree registration at this path. Restore a moved directory to its original path. If it still exists but Git links are broken, run git worktree repair there and refresh. If it was deleted and is no longer needed, archive it, then use Clean Disk to reconcile removal or Remove from Management.

en.worktree.setup.noLocalBranch: This Git repository has no local branch. Create one first:
en.worktree.setup.noRepository: This Workspace is not a Git repository. Run these commands in the Workspace directory:
en.worktree.setup.workspaceMissing: The local directory for this Workspace no longer exists. Restore it, or remove the Workspace in DSH and retry.
